newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-RONALDO AND GIOVANNI NAMED IN BRAZILIAN SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RONALDO AND GIOVANNI NAMED IN BRAZILIAN SQUAD.

text.p: Brazil coach Mario Zagallo has picked striker Ronaldo and his Barcelona team mate Giovanni in his squad for next month's friendly international at home to Cameroon.

Midfielder Mauro Silva of Spain's Deportivo Coruna was also chosen for the game in Curitiba, southern Brazil, on November 13. Zagallo said the trio would be the only foreign-based players in the squad, which will be named in full next Tuesday.
Ronaldo, whose sensational performances for Barcelona have prompted comparisons with Pele, scored a hat-trick in his last outing for Brazil -- a 3-1 home win over Lithuania earlier this month.
But Zagallo said the hype surrounding the 20-year-old was unhelpful.
"Let's forget the comparisons with Pele and recognise Ronaldo for what he is -- the best player in his position in the world," the coach said. "Ronaldo is not the past, he is the present."
Brazil and Cameroon last met in the 1994 World Cup in the United States when Brazil enjoyed a comfortable 3-0 win.
The Brazilians have never lost a full international against African opposition but were beaten 4-3 by Nigeria in the semifinal of the Olympics in Atlanta.
